name: BbY WOW Dance AI Trend: Garage Dance, Quince Meme or Your Pet
blurb: The BbY WOW dance is the TikTok trend to "BbY WOW" by KAROL G, Judeline and rusowsky: a palms-up shrug, arm slices across the body, hands on the head and a point at the camera.
